ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is a green slanted quadrilateral, whose shape is a parallelogram. The top side is labeled 15 cm, and the left slanted side is labeled 13 cm. The top side and the bottom side have the same double tick marks, and the left side and the right side have the same single tick marks, indicating that opposite sides are respectively equal. The figure also has a pink dashed height and a 7 cm horizontal offset label at the bottom, but these are auxiliary information. Reasoning: The problem asks for the perimeter of the whole figure. The perimeter of a parallelogram equals 2 times the sum of the lengths of two pairs of adjacent sides, that is P = 2(15 + 13) = 2 × 28 = 56. Therefore the perimeter is 56 cm.
